metadata.title: Agent Interconnection and Delegation

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing trust, authority, and delegation between interconnected AI agents and AI systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Agent-to-agent communication, autonomous delegation, multi-agent systems, and distributed AI architectures.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI agents establish trust, delegate authority, and restrict transitive risk across agent boundaries.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat taxonomy for multi-agent cascading failures, delegated misuse, and transitive authority escalation.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where errors, hallucinations, or misuse propagate across interconnected AI agents.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats arising when AI agents delegate capabilities or decisions beyond approved scope or without human oversight.

metadata.remarks: Agent Interconnection and Delegation defines how AI agents establish trust relationships, delegate authority, and constrain transitive risk. This pattern exists to prevent systemic failures, attribution loss, and runaway delegation in multi-agent AI environments.

components.title: Agent Trust Establishment
components.description: Explicit authorization and validation of trust relationships between AI agents before interaction or task delegation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI agents are permitted to interact or collaborate only after explicit trust establishment and policy approval.

components.title: Delegated Capability Scopes
components.description: Restriction of what authority or actions an AI agent may delegate to another agent.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Delegated tasks and permissions are limited to predefined scopes and cannot expand authority transitively.

components.title: Cross-Agent Auditability
components.description: Preservation of attribution, traceability, and accountability across agent-to-agent interactions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: All agent-to-agent interactions are logged and correlated to preserve end-to-end accountability and forensic traceability.
